items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I remember with George and I was playing with George in 45.

ctx.x: Well, anyway, we never did really talk about when you started with Joyce Lewis. Was that, you know what time that was about? I remember you played for the National Jazz Foundation on the wagon.
I remember that. I remember when that happened. I remember with George and I was playing with George in 45.
Had you been playing with him long before you went on that wagon or you just started with him?
